lines.say: Two million followers need a notification.
And your post button... just keeps spinning.
lines.show: And your post button... [just keeps spinning.]

lines.say: Here's why. Your post service does every job itself.
lines.show: Here's why. Your post service does every job *itself.*

lines.say: Notify followers. Send emails. Update feeds. One after another.
lines.show: Notify followers. Send emails. Update feeds. *One after another.*

lines.say: If email is slow, your post waits.
And every new feature means rewriting the post service. Again.
lines.show: And every new feature means [rewriting the post service.] *Again.*

lines.say: A message queue won't fix it. It hands each message to just one worker.
lines.show: A message queue won't fix it. It hands each message to just *one* worker.

lines.say: The post service publishes one message to a topic, and it's done. The button stops spinning.
lines.show: The post service *publishes* one message to a *topic,* and it's done. The button [stops spinning.]

lines.say: Every feature subscribes to that topic. Each one gets its own copy, all at the same time.
lines.show: Every feature *subscribes* to that topic. Each one gets its *own copy,* all at the same time.

lines.say: Like a radio station: it broadcasts once, and every radio tuned in hears it.
lines.show: Like a *radio station:* it broadcasts *once,* and every radio tuned in *hears it.*

lines.say: New feature? Just subscribe it. The post service never changes.
lines.show: New feature? Just *subscribe* it. The post service [never changes.]

lines.say: So those two million followers? One publish. Everyone notified.
lines.show: So those *two million* followers? *One publish.* [Everyone notified.]
